origin: User: 'the IV wall touch continuation trade is working well for NQ recently, make me the same trade using 0DTE GEX walls'. The frozen IV-wall break (iv_wall_grid_prereg.json, touch/fixed/0.4) with only the walls swapped.
walls: QQQ 0DTE call wall (upper, U) and put wall (lower, L) from data/thetadata_gex/qqq_gex_snapshots_0dte.parquet (same-day expiry only, OI = prior close), converted to NQ with ratio = NQ 5m close of the bar ending at the snapshot minute / snapshot QQQ spot. A snapshot computed at ET minute m is usable at the decision of the 5m bar starting at m (decided at m+5), so orders first rest from 09:40.

cells.fixed: walls from the session's first usable snapshot (09:35), converted once and held all session; the OCO is placed once like the IV walls.
cells.live: walls re-read at every decision from the latest snapshot no more than 20 minutes old (converted at that snapshot's ratio); the resting stop moves with the wall. A wall that jumps across price is not a touch.

trade: identical to the frozen IV-wall break: rest a 1-bar buy stop at U / sell stop at L at the nearer untouched wall, decisions slots 1..71 (orders 09:40..15:30); stop 0.4 sigma back inside (sigma = mean(VXN-implied daily move, 20-day HV), the IV-wall sigma); target 2R; engine flat 15:55; each wall side at most once a session (a wall traded through without a fill is used); one position at a time. A wall that is not strictly beyond the decision close when it first becomes usable is dead for the session (the IV rule's 'opened outside the band').
evaluator: frozen research_loop_nq.eval (MNQ, base/stress costs, side-matched random-direction twin).

windows.main: val2 2022-01-01..2026-08-14 (the only window the 0DTE snapshots cover). Caveat fixed now: NQ val2 is spent for the IV-wall family, and QQQ 0DTE 2022-01..2025-03-26 was the discovery window of gex0dte_study (call-wall break in positive gamma looked best there, longs carried it). A pass here is therefore weaker evidence than the IV-wall val2 look.
windows.fresh: 2026-08-17..2026-09-25 (Databento bars on disk, last ThetaData snapshot day): reported only, too short to judge.

gate: per cell on val2, frozen research_loop 'val' criteria: >= 100 trades, twin p < 0.05/2 = 0.025 (Bonferroni over 2 cells), net R > 0, session-bootstrap CI low > 0, stress R > 0, max year share <= 0.40, ex-top5 > 0, >= 2/3 folds positive.
reports_only: longs vs shorts, by year, by 0DTE gamma sign at entry, wall distance from the 09:35 price in sigma, exit mix, the IV-wall break on the same val2 sessions for comparison, daily overlap of the two strategies' trades.
